title: Artifact
description: Shared canonical Artifact object (ARCHITECTURE.md §33 shared-state list; content-addressed per IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN.md §9.2 'content-addressed immutable artifacts', 'sensitivity and retention on every artifact', 'secret redaction before persistence'). Reused by execution-contract-v1 (artifacts.exact[]/bounded[] entries wrap this shape), worker-capsule-v1, operation-envelope-v1 results, and legion-result-v1.

artifactKind.description: Domain kind of the artifact content, e.g. 'patch', 'exact-code', 'schema', 'fixture', 'test', 'report', 'log', 'evidence'. Not a closed enum in source docs — free string by design (judgment call, see FREEZE.md J-11).

path.description: Repository-relative path when the artifact materializes as a file; null for non-file artifacts.

denominatorDigest.description: Present when the artifact is bound to a Seer denominator (target/control/provider set), matching the nemesis artifact-record-v1 'denominatorDigest' field intent.

sensitivity.description: IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN §9.2: 'sensitivity and retention on every artifact'.

redaction.description: Same shape as nemesis execution-receipt-v1.schema.json's artifact.redaction; IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN §9.2 'secret redaction before persistence'.
